label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: A per se ordered series of efficient causes cannot go…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: Non autem est possibile quod in causis efficientibus procedatur in infinitum
interpretation: The regress premise as its own statement, restricted to per se links and formalized as well-foundedness (Lean Acc) of CausesAsCaused, exactly as the prima via's STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-MOVER-SERIES is for MovesAsMoved. Aquinas' supporting reason (no first, hence no middle and no last) is not derived: the well-foundedness reading treats the sentence as a substantive premise. Defending it from that reason and from its source, Aristotle Metaphysics II.2 994a1-19, is candidate AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-SECUNDA-VIA-REMAINING.
